shouldFire.prompt: I want to add a skill to the shared catalogue for our feature-flag process. Should it be an engine or an entry point?

Somebody on the team wrote a skill and it fires on almost every request. Review it and tell me what is wrong with it.
Add a skill to the shared catalogue that walks somebody through our incident write-up.
We want to split the catalogue skills by technology. How should the names and the descriptions change?
Write the frontmatter for a new catalogue skill so it only fires when somebody is actually doing the thing it is for.
